regions.today: Any lingering rain and cloud near east coasts will clear early this morning to leave a mostly dry and bright day with sunny spells and just isolated showers. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees in a light northwesterly or variable breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will remain dry with clear spells at first. It will turn cloudier by morning. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in a light southerly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry with hazy sunny spells at first. Cloud will build from the west through the afternoon and evening with a few patches of drizzle developing later. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in moderate southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Wednesday and Thursday.
